answer_1.quote: We approached dialogue generation as a next-turn generation task... We generated dialogues starting from each combination of speakers, thus obtaining a total of 4375 dialogues.

answer_2.quote: We also observe significantly higher BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR scores when comparing biographies and dialogue turns in the zero-shot setting... Accuracy, precision, recall and F1 are reported for speaker identification.

answer_3.quote: We fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B Instruct as LLM-as-a-judge utilising the dialogue partitions from the PRODIGy dataset... each dialogue evaluated twice, once for the target speaker and once for the interlocutor.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation For high-quality human evaluation, we recruited native English speakers from Prolific... evaluators were asked to identify the correct biography for the target speaker.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators reviewed dialogues under four interlocutor‑information configurations and selected the matching biography from three candidates.
